title: Validate hybrid MoE split quality (PPL/accuracy) before default
method: teacher-forced POST /v1/score over a fixed non-repetitive corpus (README/CONTRIBUTING/weather), offload vs hybrid --moe-hybrid-max-fetch=1, prod-like nvfp4/220k KV
interpretation: /v1/score is teacher-forced over the prompt, i.e. a PREFILL path; the hybrid CPU/GPU expert split only changes DECODE. Prefill is served by the same offload path, so the PPL being bit-identical is expected and does NOT validate the decode-time split.
The decode path is not bit-identical: 05b measured offload vs hybrid-f1 greedy outputs sharing only 374/540 chars before diverging (CPU/GPU expert rounding).
Therefore the quantitative quality of hybrid decode remains unestablished; hybrid must not become the default on the strength of this PPL result.

decision.reason: prefill quality unchanged (bit-identical PPL), but the decode-time split changes greedy output and has no accuracy evidence yet; keep offload as the default
decision.prerequisite: a decode-path accuracy campaign (GSM8K/AIME subset, offload vs hybrid) or a decode-path teacher-forced runner
